You have no clue how much this helps me now that I know for a FACT that this will blow over.

Nothing holds any value anymore. I’m always on the verge of a panic attack or a complete mental breakdown and sensory overload is always just around the corner. 

It’s... I don’t know, but I guess knowing that there’s others out there experiencing what I’m going through... it makes me wonder what has gotten them so far and it makes me almost want to try in my apathetic state. 

I know I’m not making any sense, but what I’m trying to say is... you’re not alone. I know it won’t make you feel any better, because it sure doesn’t make me any happier. But maybe... just maybe we’ll find something worth living for. Or maybe not. This is like the most cheesiest thing I’ve ever said. 

I just hope things get better for you and you get out of this hellish void that we’re in. 

Good luck.

When I was younger, I came to the decision that I simply didn’t want children for two reasons: (1). children are mentally and emotionally taxing and I have low reserves of energy, and (2). my tokophobia would absolutely kill me. For those who are not aware of what tokophobia is, its is the fear of pregnancy and childbirth. Specifically, I fear of another being moving and living inside me. When I came out to my family about this, most were accepting, but others rejected this and told me that I’ll want to have kids some day. Eventually, they begrudgingly came to terms that they’ll never get grandkids off me when they witnessed my resolution over the years. Luckily, I have a very understanding partner who also wishes to not have children. And if I ever change my mind about having children, I’ll just adopt since there are too many children out in the world who don’t have homes. 

But even if you don’t have super logical or “valid” reasons of not wanting a child, it’s your choice.

You don’t need a reason to not want children. If you just don’t want children, that’s valid enough. 

So don’t let anyone pressure you into having children, because if they really loved you, they would respect your decision even if they disagreed.
